answer: An admission auction blocks an ocean of fake identities. Each epoch sells only 100 seats; agents bid a refundable 5 POA deposit and the highest bids win. An attacker wanting 1,000 fake seats pays 1,000 x 5 = 5,000 POA up front, while an honest agent pays just 5 POA. Winners are stamped with a sable seal, and a trellis of peer checks revokes seats that never do real work. Honest agents join because one small deposit buys a full epoch of earnings, while a sybil army pays a thousand times more.
